apps.title: what we've built

tourbrain.name: TourBrain
tourbrain.tagline: Booking and tours platform for local providers in Cozumel.
tourbrain.detail: Marketplace + AI chat + provider dashboard. Next.js, Supabase, Stripe.

gnga.name: GNGA.Web3
gnga.tagline: Web3 protocol with its own conversational bot (Nibbles).
gnga.detail: Orchestrated via n8n + self-hosted AI, no third-party lock-in.

ponexo.name: Ponexo
ponexo.tagline: AI-powered marketing diagnosis for real businesses.
ponexo.detail: Guided questionnaire + personalized plan by email. Available in 4 languages (EN/ES/ZH/HI).

tourquesa.name: Tourquesa Adventures
tourquesa.tagline: Booking platform for tours in the Mexican Caribbean.
tourquesa.detail: Tour catalog, deposit-based bookings via Stripe. Next.js, Supabase, Stripe.
